source_provenance.original_asset_policy: Local assets embedded unchanged. CSS layouts may scale/crop photographs; no raster retouching or invented venue/food imagery.

reproduction: From Website root: npm ci; npx playwright install chromium; node scripts/render-holiday-series-nye.mjs.
Optional HOLIDAY_RENDER_DEPS and HOLIDAY_RENDER_BROWSER_CHANNEL select compatible local dependencies/browser.
Renderer blocks page network requests and writes only series/nye exports, QA previews and this manifest; no app build, environment-file reads or production access.

qa.actual_platform_preview: Still required; house Story margins are not platform certification.

December28 thisThursday applies to December31 2026; if soldout replace with guest-service information.
